title: poincare-memory: hierarchy-aware, time-aware memory for LLM agents on the Poincaré ball
description: Official open-source reference implementation of the geometry-aware memory component of 'LLM Orchestration with Geometry-Aware Memory' (IEEE ICBDML 2026, doi:10.1109/ICBDML68582.2026.11544690). Written after the paper from its description; the original experimental system is not released.
